name: Nature’s Vanguard (Marshal Archetype)
body:
No matter the state of things, nature often needs a champion to defend it and these marshals accept that honor. They fight not for the armies of civilization, but lead animals and the people of the unconquered lands.

Hit Die: d8

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A nature’s vanguard is proficient with all simple and martial weapons, light and medium armor, and shields (but not tower shields). This modifies the marshal’s weapon and armor proficiencies.

Animal Companion (Ex)

A nature’s vanguard always needs a faithful companion.

At 1st level, they gain an animal companion as the druid’s class feature using their class level as their effective druid level. A nature’s vanguard readies three fewer auras per day. This means they cannot ready any auras until 4th level.

This ability modifies auras.

Vital Bond (Ex)

At 2nd level, nature’s vanguards can command their animals from greater distance and with added benefits. When using their inspire action ability on their animal companion, they increase the range by 30 feet.

Additionally, when granted an action by the nature’s vanguard the animal companion regains hit points equal to the animal’s Constitution score plus plus the nature’s vanguard’s class level.

This ability replaces vital inspiration.

Coordinated Companion (Ex)

At 3rd level, the teamwork between a nature’s vanguard and their animal companion is deeper than with others. Both gain a bonus teamwork feat for which they meet the prerequisites. Additionally, whenever the nature’s vanguard gains a teamwork feat, the animal companion automatically gains that feat even if they do not meet the prerequisites.

Animal Focus (Su)

At 4th level, a nature’s vanguard can take on the aspect of an animal as a swift action.

She must select one type of animal to emulate, gaining a bonus or special ability based on the type of animal emulated and their class level. A nature’s vanguard can use this ability for a number of times per day equal to their Wisdom modifier and each use of the ability lasts for 10 minutes. A nature’s vanguard can emulate only one animal at a time.

A nature’s vanguard can also apply one of these aspects to their animal companion. Unlike with the nature’s vanguard themself, and there is no duration on the animal aspect applied to the animal companion. An aspect applied in this way does not count against the nature’s vanguard’s uses per day—it remains in effect until the nature’s vanguard changes it. The companion’s aspect can be the same aspect as the nature’s vanguard or a different one. The nature’s vanguard can select or change the animal foci on both themselves and their animal companion as part of the same swift action.

If a nature’s vanguard’s animal companion is dead, the nature’s vanguard can apply their companion’s animal focus to themselves instead. This use does not count against their uses per day, and has an unlimited duration just as though it were applied to the animal companion.

Listed below are the animal aspects available to the nature’s vanguard.

Animal Aspects

Bat: The creature gains darkvision to a range of 60 feet. At 8th level, the range increases by 30 feet. At 15th level, the creature also gains blindsense to a range of 10 feet.
Bear: The creature gains a +2 enhancement bonus to Constitution. This bonus increases to +4 at 8th level and +6 at 15th level.
Bull: The creature gains a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength. This bonus increases to +4 at 8th level and +6 at 15th level.
Falcon: The creature gains a +4 competence bonus on Perception checks. This bonus increases to +6 at 8th level and +8 at 15th level.
Frog: The creature gains a +4 competence bonus on Swim checks and on Acrobatics checks to jump. These bonuses increase to +6 at 8th level and +8 at 15th level.
Monkey: The creature gains a +4 competence bonus on Climb checks. This bonus increases to +6 at 8th level and +8 at 15th level.
Mouse: The creature gains evasion, as the rogue class feature. At 12th level, this increases to improved evasion, as the rogue advanced talent.
Owl: The creature gains a +4 competence bonus on Stealth checks. This bonus increases to +6 at 8th level and +8 at 15th level.
Snake: The creature gains a +2 bonus on attack rolls when making attacks of opportunity and a +2 dodge bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity. These bonuses increase to +4 at 8th level and +6 at 15th level.
Stag: The creature gains a 5-foot enhancement bonus to its base land speed. This bonus increases to 10 feet at 8th level and 20 feet at 15th level.
Tiger: The creature gains a +2 enhancement bonus to Dexterity. This bonus increases to +4 at 8th level and +6 at 15th level.
Wolf: The creature gains the scent ability with a range of 10 feet. The range of this sense increases to 20 feet at 8th level and 30 feet at 15th level. The range doubles if the opponent is upwind, and is halved if the opponent is downwind.

This ability replaces tactician, greater tactician, and master tactician.
